explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1068: every graph with chromatic number ℵ_1 has a countable vertex set s whose induced subgraph is infinitely (vertex-)connected. InfinitelyConnected means at least two vertices, with every pair joined by infinitely many internally disjoint paths. Using induced subgraphs loses nothing, because adding edges preserves infinite connectivity. Finite s cannot qualify, so 'countable' effectively means countably infinite, as intended.
